test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: At what rate of interest (rounded off to two decimal places) per year will a sum of money double itself in 12 years on simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Time (t) = 12 years

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) (since the sum doubles itself)

**Formula used:**

SI = P × t × r / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = P × t × r / 100

⇒ P = P × 12 × r / 100

⇒ r = 100 / 12

⇒ r = 8.33%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
